plain_summary_en: This paper studies Communication in Mental Health Care: A Narrative Review of Conversation Analytic Studies in Clinical Settings. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Mental, Health, Care, Narrative. The abstract suggests a review approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
